extracted.intended_audience: CIA ADP customer/user offices and ADP service organizations (agency program directors and ADP coordinators) preparing the Semiannual Report on ADP Accomplishments required by OMB Circular A-79
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for preparing the Agency's semiannual report on ADP (automatic data processing) accomplishments required by OMB Circular A-79, covering new/revised computer-based systems and ADP management accomplishments for the reporting period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inputs for Section I — Describe new and revised ADP applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Inputs for Section I should describe new and revised ADP applications -- information normally furnished by ADP customer/user offices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe and explain the benefits of each NEW OR REVISED computer-based system implemented during this report period. Information normally furnished by DP customer/user offices such as OER, OSI, 02, OFF IMSAC, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section I — System Description (A)
rubrics_metrics.description: Briefly identify and explain the intelligence (or other) functions and objectives which the computerized system supports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include identification of the Agency Program supported (i.e., category, subcategory, element, etc.), identify and explain any contractor involvement, and indicate any community interest or use of the system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quantify manual-equivalent manpower (Section I benefit estimate)
rubrics_metrics.description: Furnish your estimate and briefly explain the number of additional people (or man years) that would be required for the Agency to accomplish the objectives of this computer-based system if we were to perform the necessary functions manually (i.e., without a computer).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide numerical estimate of added staff or man-years avoided by the computerized system; explain assumptions and basis for the estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Describe other benefits (Section I)
rubrics_metrics.description: Briefly explain other benefits of this computerized system such as increases in efficiency, timeliness, accuracy, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discuss qualitative and quantitative improvements (efficiency, timeliness, accuracy, etc.) and how the system advances mission objectives or operational performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inputs for Section II — ADP management accomplishments
rubrics_metrics.description: Inputs for Section II should describe computer operations management accomplishments -- information normally furnished by ADP service organizations such as OCS, ISD, CRS and AID (NPIC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Section II is normally prepared by ADP service organizations (e.g., OCS, MID, CRS, NPIC) and should explain benefits of management/operational accomplishments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Estimate ADP equipment, manpower or dollar impact (Section II)
rubrics_metrics.description: Please furnish your estimate of the ADP equipment, manpower or dollar [savings/impact] associated with the described management accomplishments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide estimates (equipment replacement/standardization impact, manpower savings, dollar savings or costs avoided) tied to each management accomplishment; state methodology for estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standardization or integration of computer system
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe and explain benefits of standardization or integration of computer system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain what standardization/integration actions were taken, how they reduce redundancy/complexity, and estimate resulting efficiencies or cost savings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improvements in ADP methods or technology
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe and explain benefits of improvements in ADP methods or technology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document methods/technology changes (process improvements, new tools or techniques), impacts on performance, reliability, maintainability, and mission support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Negotiation of ADP contracts under more favorable terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe negotiations of ADP contracts under more favorable terms than provided in the Federal Supply Schedule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain contract changes secured, why terms are more favorable, and provide estimates of cost savings or improved service levels resulting from the negotiations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress in handling ADP security problems
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe progress in handling ADP security problems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detail security actions taken (policy, procedures, technical measures), incidents addressed, and how improvements mitigate risk or compliance issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress on research and development of advanced ADP systems
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe progress on research and development of advanced ADP systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize R&D efforts, milestones achieved, potential operational benefits, and plans for transition to operations where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide source/responsibility for inputs
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify which organization should furnish each section's inputs (Section I: ADP customer/user offices; Section II: ADP service organizations).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the document's allocation of responsibility: customer/user offices (e.g., OER, OSI, OFF IMSAC) supply Section I; service organizations (OCS, MID, CRS, NPIC) supply Section II.

rubrics_metrics.name: Classification of Agency report determined by submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: The Agency's report to the International Programs Division, OMB will be classified at the security level indicated by your submissions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure each submission's security classification is accurate and consistent with the material provided, because the compiled report's classification will reflect submitted content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission deadline and response routing
rubrics_metrics.description: Furnish your response to the Information Processing Coordinator by 24 January 1972 (per memorandum).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide completed inputs to the named coordinator by the stated deadline; include distribution instructions if provided (e.g., Orig & I - Mdse 2 - DTR I -- ISS Tail/ISS).
